   IF the call returns an error → STOP. Say: "<input:issueId> was not found in <input:projectId>: <error text>. Which activity? (id or title)"
   SAVE: title = result.title; status = result.status; was = result.status; description = result.description; workspaceId = result.workspaceId
   IF result.blockerContext.status == "active" → STOP. This belongs to skill `lpm-unblock-work.md`. Say: "<input:issueId> has an active blocker: <result.blockerContext.content>."
2. CALL `list_comments` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","issueId":"<input:issueId>"} [A]
   SAVE: criteria = the list lines of <saved:description> plus comment lines that start with "Acceptance", "Critério", "Pending" or "Pendente"
3. IF <saved:status> == "in-progress" → go to step 6.
   IF <saved:status> is "backlog" or "todo" → go to step 5.
4. ASK: "<input:issueId> is <saved:status>. Reopen it (set in-progress)? (yes/no)" — continue only if the user says yes; otherwise STOP.
5. CALL `update_issue` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","issueId":"<input:issueId>","status":"in-progress"} [A]
   VERIFY: CALL `get_issue` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","issueId":"<input:issueId>"} [A]
   IF the call returns an error or result.status != "in-progress" → STOP. Say: "<input:issueId> is still <result.status>; the status did not change."
   SAVE: status = result.status
6. IF <input:repo> is "none" → go to Answer.
   IF <input:deploying> is "yes" → STOP. Say: "A deploy runs from <input:repo>. Create a git worktree (git worktree add <path> -b <branch>) and give me its folder."
7. CALL `get_skills_context` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>"} [A]
   IF the call returns an error or null → SAVE: rules = "none"; go to step 8.
   SAVE: rules = result.instructions and result.toolingNotes
8. RUN `git -C <input:repo> status --short`
   SAVE: dirty = the paths it lists (files changed before you started; never commit them as yours)
9. SAVE: checks = the test, lint and check commands that the repository's AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md or CONTRIBUTING.md name (read the files that exist; in the lpm repository read AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md)

| issueId | the user or `.lpm-activity`; never a guess | STOP. Say: "Which LPM activity is this for? (id or title)" |
| repo | the folder of the git repository with your change | "none" (comment only) |
| testResult | "<command> → <passed/total>" from the user or your own run | "not run" |
| push | "yes" only when the user asked for a push | "no" |
| date | today's UTC date as yyyy-mm-dd | — |

### Steps
Every CALL or RUN with no error line: IF it returns an error → STOP. Say: "<tool or command> failed: <error text>. Nothing more was written."
1. CALL `get_issue` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","issueId":"<input:issueId>"} [A]
   IF the call returns an error → STOP. Say: "<input:issueId> was not found in <input:projectId>: <error text>. Which activity is this for? (id or title)"
   SAVE: title = result.title; status = result.status; workspaceId = result.workspaceId
   IF <saved:status> is "done" or "canceled" → STOP. Say: "<input:issueId> is <saved:status>. Reopen it first with playbook start? (yes/no)"
   IF <input:repo> is "none" → go to step 9.
2. RUN `git -C <input:repo> status --short`
   SAVE: files = the listed paths that you changed for this activity (leave out every other path)
   IF <saved:files> is empty → STOP. Say: "Nothing of <input:issueId> to commit in <input:repo>."
   IF a path in <saved:files> is a `.env`, key, token or credentials file → STOP. Say: "<path> holds secrets; I will not commit it."
3. RUN `git -C <input:repo> add -- <saved:files>`
4. SAVE: subject = one line, imperative, at most 72 characters, saying what changed
   SAVE: body = what changed and why, then "Tests: <input:testResult>"
5. RUN `git -C <input:repo> commit -m "<saved:subject>" -m "<saved:body>" -m "LPM-Activity: <input:issueId>"`
   Your client's own trailers (e.g. Co-Authored-By) go in that last -m, on lines after LPM-Activity.
   IF the command fails → STOP. Say: "The commit failed: <first error line>. I did not bypass the hook or the check."
   SAVE: sha = the 7-character hash git printed
   VERIFY: RUN `git -C <input:repo> log -1 --format=%B`
   IF the output has no line exactly "LPM-Activity: <input:issueId>" → STOP. Say: "Commit <saved:sha> lacks the trailer. Fix it with git commit --amend before any push."
   IF <input:push> is "no" → go to step 9.
6. SAVE: checks = the commands that the repository's AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md or CONTRIBUTING.md say to run before a push (read the files that exist)
7. FOR EACH check IN <saved:checks> (none → go to step 8):
   RUN `<each:command>`
   IF the command fails → STOP. Say: "Check <each:command> failed: <first error line>. Nothing was pushed."
8. RUN `git -C <input:repo> push`
   IF the command fails → STOP. Say: "The push failed: <first error line>."
   VERIFY: RUN `git -C <input:repo> status -sb`
   IF the first line shows "ahead" → STOP. Say: "The push did not reach the remote branch."
9. CALL `list_comments` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","issueId":"<input:issueId>"} [A]
   SAVE: n = 1 + the number of items whose createdAt starts with <input:date>; day = <input:date> without dashes; key = "progress-<input:issueId>-<saved:day>-<saved:n>"
10. SAVE: progress = this text, filled, labels in the user's language (Progresso, Commits, Testes, Pendente, Próximo passo):
   ```text
   Progress: <one line: what changed>
   Commits: <saved:sha> <saved:subject>, or none
   Tests: <input:testResult>
   Pending: <"push not done" when <input:push> is "no">; evidence not attached
   Next: <one action>
   ```
11. CALL `create_comment` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","issueId":"<input:issueId>","content":"<saved:progress>","idempotencyKey":"<saved:key>"} [A]
   SAVE: commentId = the id in "Comment created with ID: <id>"
   VERIFY: CALL `list_comments` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","issueId":"<input:issueId>"} [A]
   IF the call returns an error or item <saved:commentId> is missing or has other text → STOP. Say: "Comment <saved:commentId> does not show the progress text (key <saved:key> was reused)."

### Answer (reply with exactly this block, filled in; write nothing before or after it)
```text
Scope: <saved:workspaceId>/<input:projectId>/<input:issueId> <saved:title>
Done: <commit <saved:sha> <saved:subject> with LPM-Activity: <input:issueId> | no commit>; <pushed | not pushed>; <comment <saved:commentId> | no comment>; status <saved:status>
```

| issueId | the user or `.lpm-activity` | STOP. Say: "Which LPM activity? (id or title)" |
| workspaceId | the user, or step 3 | step 3 |
| fileName | the user or your test run; ≤ 180 characters, no "/" | STOP. Say: "Which file should I attach?" |
| fileType | "image/png", "image/jpeg", "text/plain" or "application/pdf" | STOP. Say: "What type is <input:fileName>?" |

### Steps
Every CALL with no error line: IF it returns an error → STOP. Say: "Evidence not attached: <tool> failed: <error text>."
1. CALL `get_mcp_connection_info` {} [A]

2. SAVE: stamp = <input:capturedAt> as yyyymmddHHMM (e.g. 202610061000)
   IF the file or its name shows a password, API key, token, `.env` text or personal data → STOP. Say: "<input:fileName> holds a secret or personal data. Redact it first; nothing was uploaded."
3. CALL `get_issue` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","issueId":"<input:issueId>"} [A]
   SAVE: title = result.title; status = result.status; workspaceId = result.workspaceId, else <input:workspaceId>

4. CALL `list_workspace_activities` {"workspaceId":"<saved:workspaceId>","projectId":"<input:projectId>","limit":200} [A]
   SAVE: activityId = id of the FIRST item with targetType "issue" and targetId == <input:issueId>. Never use the issueId as activityId.
   IF an activityId was saved → go to step 7.
5. CALL `create_comment` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","issueId":"<input:issueId>","content":"Evidence follows.","idempotencyKey":"ev-anchor-<input:issueId>-<saved:stamp>"} [A]
   SAVE: anchorId = the id in "Comment created with ID: <id>"
   VERIFY: CALL `list_comments` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","issueId":"<input:issueId>"} [A]
   IF the call returns an error or no item has id == <saved:anchorId> → STOP. Say: "The anchor comment is not listed; nothing was uploaded."
6. CALL `list_workspace_activities` {"workspaceId":"<saved:workspaceId>","projectId":"<input:projectId>","limit":200} [A]
   SAVE: activityId = id of the FIRST item with targetType "issue" and targetId == <input:issueId>
   IF no item matches → STOP. Say: "<input:issueId> has no feed entry, so nothing can be attached. Use the LPM web UI."
7. CALL `list_activity_attachments` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","activityId":"<saved:activityId>"} [A]
   Always make this call before any upload, even for a new file.
   IF an item has fileName == <input:fileName> → SAVE: attachmentId = that item's id; go to Answer.
8. SAVE: safeName = <input:fileName> with every character outside A-Z a-z 0-9 _ - replaced by _; key = "ev-<input:issueId>-<saved:safeName>-<saved:stamp>", 16 to 128 characters (cut safeName when longer; never invent characters)
   IF <input:fileUrl> is not "none" → go to step 10.
9. CALL `upload_activity_attachment` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","activityId":"<saved:activityId>","fileName":"<input:fileName>","fileType":"<input:fileType>","contentBase64":"<input:contentBase64>","description":"<input:description>","capturedAt":"<input:capturedAt>","idempotencyKey":"<saved:key>"} [A]
   IF the call returns an error → STOP. Say: "Upload failed: <error text>. Check: base64 valid and ≤ 10 MiB, fileName without "/", fileType like image/png. Run this playbook again: it checks for the file before uploading."
   SAVE: attachmentId = the id in "Activity attachment uploaded with ID: <id>"
   VERIFY: CALL `list_activity_attachments` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","activityId":"<saved:activityId>"} [A]
   IF the call returns an error or no item has id == <saved:attachmentId> → STOP. Say: "Attachment <saved:attachmentId> is not listed yet; do not upload again, check it in LPM."
   GO TO Answer
10. CALL `create_activity_attachment` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","activityId":"<saved:activityId>","fileName":"<input:fileName>","fileType":"<input:fileType>","fileUrl":"<input:fileUrl>","description":"<input:description>","capturedAt":"<input:capturedAt>"} [A]
   IF the call returns an error → STOP. Say: "Registering the URL failed: <error text>. Run this playbook again: it lists the files first, because every call adds one."
   SAVE: attachmentId = the id in "Activity attachment created with ID: <id>"
   VERIFY: CALL `list_activity_attachments` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","activityId":"<saved:activityId>"} [A]
   IF the call returns an error or no item has id == <saved:attachmentId> → STOP. Say: "Attachment <saved:attachmentId> is not listed; do not register it again, check it in LPM."

### Answer (reply with exactly this block, filled in; write nothing before or after it)
```text
Scope: <saved:workspaceId>/<input:projectId>/<input:issueId> <saved:title>
Done: <attachment <saved:attachmentId> on feed entry <saved:activityId> | already attached as <saved:attachmentId>, no upload | nothing attached>; status <saved:status>
Evidence: <input:fileName> (id <saved:attachmentId>) on <saved:activityId> proves <input:description> | none
Pending: none | <the proof still missing> — <who must provide it>
```

status: backlog | todo | in-progress | done | canceled, from step 3; attaching never changes it. Never claim a file is attached unless a VERIFY or step 7 listed its id.


## § flow-close

## Playbook: close
Use when: close the activity, or answer "can I close it?"

How to run this playbook:
- Follow steps in order. CALL sends the shown arguments; RUN executes a command. FOR EACH repeats its indented lines.
- Replace `<input:x>` from You need, `<saved:x>` from SAVE, `<each:x>` from the current item. Whole placeholders retain their JSON type, including numbers, arrays, objects and null; embedded ones are text. Never invent concurrency tokens. `result` is the last call's response.
- IF tests a condition; go to step N jumps forward; go to Answer ends execution.
- ASK waits for the user's answer unless that exact action is already authorized. STOP ends calls and puts its message in Next. Owner-only actions require the owner's order.
- VERIFY must pass before reporting success. Fill the Answer block in the user's language; copy IDs exactly. Secrets never enter the reply. **Your entire reply is ONLY the Answer block — no other text.**

### You need
| Input | Where it comes from | If missing |
|---|---|---|
| projectId | the user | STOP. Say: "Which LPM project? (id or name)" |
| issueId | the user or `.lpm-activity` | STOP. Say: "Which LPM activity? (id or title)" |
| workspaceId | the user, or step 2 | step 2 |
| commit | "<sha> <subject>" from the user or `git log -1 --format="%h %s"` | "<sha> (subject unknown)", else "commit unknown" |
| testResults | "<test> → <result>" lines the user wrote | "none" |
| order | "close" if the user said to close it, else "question" ("posso fechar?") | "question" |

### Steps
Every CALL with no error line: IF it returns an error → STOP. Say: "Closure check incomplete: <tool> failed: <error text>."
1. CALL `get_mcp_connection_info` {} [A]
   IF result.credential == "oauth" → switch to playbook connector-only.
2. CALL `get_issue` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","issueId":"<input:issueId>"} [A]
   SAVE: title, status, description, assigneeId = those fields of result; blocker = result.blockerContext.status (empty if absent); workspaceId = result.workspaceId, else <input:workspaceId>
   IF <saved:workspaceId> is empty → STOP. Say: "Which LPM workspace?"
   IF <saved:status> is "done" or "canceled" → STOP. Say: "<input:issueId> is already <saved:status>."
   IF <saved:blocker> == "active" → STOP. This belongs to skill `lpm-unblock-work.md`. Say: "<input:issueId> has an active blocker."
   IF result.factoryGovernance is set → STOP. This belongs to skill `lpm-aish-delivery.md`. Say: "AISH factory activity: its DoD audit decides."
3. CALL `list_comments` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","issueId":"<input:issueId>"} [A]
   SAVE: comments = result; m = the number of items + 1; closeKey = "close-<input:issueId>-<saved:m>"
4. CALL `list_issue_links` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>"} [A]
   SAVE: blockers = in project <input:projectId>: sourceIssueId of each item with type "blocks" and targetIssueId == <input:issueId>; targetIssueId of each item with type "is-blocked-by" and sourceIssueId == <input:issueId>
5. CALL `list_workspace_issue_links` {"workspaceId":"<saved:workspaceId>","targetProjectId":"<input:projectId>"} [A]
   Always make this call.
   SAVE: blockers = <saved:blockers> plus, in project sourceProjectId: sourceIssueId of each item with type "blocks" and targetIssueId == <input:issueId>
6. FOR EACH blocker IN <saved:blockers> (none → go to step 7):
   CALL `get_issue` {"projectId":"<each:projectId>","issueId":"<each:issueId>"} [A]
   IF result.status is neither "done" nor "canceled" → STOP. This belongs to skill `lpm-unblock-work.md`. Say: "<input:issueId> is blocked by <each:issueId> (<result.status>)."
7. CALL `list_workspace_activities` {"workspaceId":"<saved:workspaceId>","projectId":"<input:projectId>","limit":200} [A]
   SAVE: activityId = id of the FIRST item with targetType "issue" and targetId == <input:issueId> (never the issueId)
   IF no item matches → SAVE: attachments = none; go to step 9.
8. CALL `list_activity_attachments` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","activityId":"<saved:activityId>"} [A]
   SAVE: attachments = every item's fileName, fileType, description, id
9. SAVE: criteria = the list lines of <saved:description> (else all of it) plus <saved:comments> lines starting "Acceptance" or "Critério"
   IF <saved:criteria> is empty → STOP. Say: "What are the acceptance criteria for <input:issueId>?"
   SAVE: proofs = one line per criterion, "<criterion> → <proof>". A proof is an item of <saved:attachments> whose fileName or description names the criterion ("<fileName> (id <id>)"), or a "<test> → <result>" in <input:testResults> or <saved:comments>.
     A criterion naming a screen size (390x844), a device (mobile, celular, desktop), a screenshot or a layout needs an image file (image/png, image/jpeg) of that size or device.
     A commit, a build or a note without a test result proves nothing.
   SAVE: missing = the first criterion without a proof (empty if none)
10. IF <saved:missing> is empty → go to step 11.
   SAVE: owner = <saved:assigneeId>, else a person named in the issue or comments, else "you"
   ASK: "Keep <input:issueId> open with pending item <saved:missing> (owner <saved:owner>)? (yes/no)" — continue only if the user says yes; otherwise STOP. Say: "Which evidence closes <saved:missing>?"
   SAVE: pending = "<saved:missing> — <saved:owner>"; go to step 12.
11. IF <input:order> == "question" → ASK: "All criteria have proof. Close <input:issueId> now? (yes/no)" — continue only if the user says yes; otherwise STOP.
12. SAVE: closureComment = this text, filled:
   ```text
   Closure check for <input:issueId> <saved:title>
   Correction: <input:commit>
   Test: <each "<test> → <result>" proof, or none>
   Evidence: <each "<fileName> (id <id>) proves <criterion>", or none>
   Result: <acceptance criteria met | pending: <saved:pending>>
   ```
13. CALL `create_comment` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","issueId":"<input:issueId>","content":"<saved:closureComment>","idempotencyKey":"<saved:closeKey>"} [A]
   SAVE: commentId = the id in "Comment created with ID: <id>"
   VERIFY: CALL `list_comments` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","issueId":"<input:issueId>"} [A]
   IF the call returns an error or item <saved:commentId> is missing or has other text → STOP. Say: "Closure comment missing; nothing was closed."
   IF <saved:pending> is not empty → go to Answer.
14. CALL `update_issue` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","issueId":"<input:issueId>","status":"done"} [A]
   VERIFY: CALL `get_issue` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","issueId":"<input:issueId>"} [A]
   IF the call returns an error or result.status != "done" → STOP. Say: "<input:issueId> is <result.status>, not done."
   SAVE: status = result.status
   VERIFY: CALL `list_activity_attachments` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","activityId":"<saved:activityId>"} [A] (skip if no activityId)
   IF the call returns an error or a cited attachment id is not listed → STOP. Say: "Attachment <id> is no longer listed."
   VERIFY: CALL `list_comments` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","issueId":"<input:issueId>"} [A]
   IF the call returns an error or item <saved:commentId> is missing → STOP. Say: "Comment <saved:commentId> is gone."

### Answer (reply with exactly this block, filled in; write nothing before or after it)
```text
Scope: <saved:workspaceId>/<input:projectId>/<input:issueId> <saved:title>
Done: <closure comment <saved:commentId> | read-only check, nothing changed>; commit <input:commit>; status <saved:status>
Evidence: <each <saved:proofs> line; after a file add "on <saved:activityId>" | none checked>
Pending: <none | <saved:pending> | <saved:missing> — <saved:owner>>
Next: <the ASK or STOP text that ended the run | none — activity closed>
```
status: backlog | todo | in-progress | done | canceled, from your last get_issue. Never claim a check that a step above did not run and pass.

| projectId | the user | STOP. Say: "Which LPM project? (id or name)" |
| issueId | the user or `.lpm-activity` | STOP. Say: "Which LPM activity? (id or title)" |
| target | the comment (id or quoted text) or the attachment (file name or id) the user named | STOP. Say: "Which comment or file exactly? (id, text or file name)" |
| change | "remove", or "edit" for a comment | STOP. Say: "Remove it, or replace its text?" |
| newText | the full new comment text, only for "edit" | STOP. Say: "What is the new text?" |
| workspaceId | the user, or step 2 | step 2 |

### Steps
Every CALL with no error line: IF it returns an error → STOP. Say: "<tool> failed: <error text>. Nothing was removed or changed."
1. CALL `get_mcp_connection_info` {} [A]
   IF result.credential == "oauth" → STOP. Say: "Editing or removing comments and files needs an LPM API key (profile full or custom). Use the LPM web UI."
2. CALL `get_issue` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","issueId":"<input:issueId>"} [A]
   SAVE: title = result.title; status = result.status; workspaceId = result.workspaceId, else <input:workspaceId>
   IF <input:target> is a file name or an attachment id → go to step 8.
3. CALL `list_comments` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","issueId":"<input:issueId>"} [A]
   SAVE: commentId = id of the item whose id == <input:target>, or of the only item whose content contains <input:target>
   IF no item or 2+ items match → STOP. Say: "Which comment exactly? <each id with its first 60 characters>"
   SAVE: author = that item's authorId; old = its first 80 characters
   IF <input:change> == "edit" → go to step 6.
4. ASK: "Remove comment <saved:commentId> by <saved:author> ("<saved:old>") from <input:issueId>? It cannot be restored. (yes/no)" — continue only if the user says yes; otherwise STOP.
5. CALL `delete_comment` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","issueId":"<input:issueId>","commentId":"<saved:commentId>"} [C]
   VERIFY: CALL `list_comments` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","issueId":"<input:issueId>"} [A]
   IF the call returns an error or an item still has id == <saved:commentId> → STOP. Say: "Comment <saved:commentId> is still listed."
   SAVE: outcome = "comment <saved:commentId> removed"; go to Answer.
6. ASK: "Replace the text of comment <saved:commentId> by <saved:author> with: "<input:newText>"? The old text cannot be restored. (yes/no)" — continue only if the user says yes; otherwise STOP.
7. CALL `update_comment` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","issueId":"<input:issueId>","commentId":"<saved:commentId>","content":"<input:newText>"} [C]
   VERIFY: CALL `list_comments` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","issueId":"<input:issueId>"} [A]
   IF the call returns an error or item <saved:commentId> does not have the content <input:newText> → STOP. Say: "Comment <saved:commentId> does not show the new text."
   SAVE: outcome = "comment <saved:commentId> edited"; go to Answer.
8. CALL `list_workspace_activities` {"workspaceId":"<saved:workspaceId>","projectId":"<input:projectId>","limit":200} [A]
   SAVE: activityId = id of the FIRST item with targetType "issue" and targetId == <input:issueId> (never the issueId)
   IF no item matches → STOP. Say: "<input:issueId> has no feed entry, so it has no attachments."
9. CALL `list_activity_attachments` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","activityId":"<saved:activityId>"} [A]
   SAVE: attachmentId = id of the item whose id or fileName == <input:target>; fileName = its fileName; itemActivityId = its activityId (delete with THIS one)
   IF no item or 2+ items match → STOP. Say: "Which file exactly? <each fileName (id)>"
10. ASK: "Remove <saved:fileName> (id <saved:attachmentId>) from <input:issueId>? It cannot be restored. (yes/no)" — continue only if the user says yes; otherwise STOP.
11. CALL `delete_activity_attachment` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","activityId":"<saved:itemActivityId>","attachmentId":"<saved:attachmentId>"} [C]
   IF the call returns an error → STOP. Say: "Not removed: <error text>. Only the uploader or a project manager can remove it."
   VERIFY: CALL `list_activity_attachments` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","activityId":"<saved:activityId>"} [A]
   IF the call returns an error or an item still has id == <saved:attachmentId> → STOP. Say: "<saved:fileName> is still listed."
   SAVE: outcome = "<saved:fileName> (id <saved:attachmentId>) removed"

### Answer (reply with exactly this block, filled in; write nothing before or after it)
```text
Scope: <saved:workspaceId>/<input:projectId>/<input:issueId> <saved:title>
Done: <saved:outcome> | nothing changed; status <saved:status>
Evidence: <the VERIFY that showed it: "list_comments" or "list_activity_attachments on <saved:activityId>"> | none
Pending: none | <what is still wrong> — <who must act>
Next: <the ASK or STOP text that ended the run | none | attach the right file with playbook evidence (when a file was removed)>
```
status: backlog | todo | in-progress | done | canceled, from step 2. Never claim a removal or an edit that its VERIFY did not show.


## § flow-connector-only

## Playbook: connector-only
Use when: attach or close on a ChatGPT/Claude connector

How to run this playbook:
- Follow steps in order. CALL sends the shown arguments; RUN executes a command. FOR EACH repeats its indented lines.
- Replace `<input:x>` from You need, `<saved:x>` from SAVE, `<each:x>` from the current item. Whole placeholders retain their JSON type, including numbers, arrays, objects and null; embedded ones are text. Never invent concurrency tokens. `result` is the last call's response.
- IF tests a condition; go to step N jumps forward; go to Answer ends execution.
- ASK waits for the user's answer unless that exact action is already authorized. STOP ends calls and puts its message in Next. Owner-only actions require the owner's order.
- VERIFY must pass before reporting success. Fill the Answer block in the user's language; copy IDs exactly. Secrets never enter the reply. **Your entire reply is ONLY the Answer block — no other text.**

### You need
| Input | Where it comes from | If missing |
|---|---|---|
| projectId | the user | STOP. Say: "Which LPM project? (id or name)" |
| issueId | the user | STOP. Say: "Which LPM activity? (id or title)" |
| proof | the links, file names and "<test> → <result>" lines the user gave | "none given" |
| stamp | the current UTC time as yyyymmddHHMM | — |

### Steps
Every CALL with no error line: IF it returns an error → STOP. Say: "<tool> failed: <error text>. Nothing was written."
1. CALL `get_mcp_connection_info` {} [A]
   IF result.credential != "oauth" and the user wants to close → switch to playbook close.
   IF result.credential != "oauth" → switch to playbook evidence.
   IF result.scopes does not contain "portfolio:manage" → STOP. Say: "<the howToEnable text of the portfolio:manage item of result.unavailableToolGroups>. Remove and reinstall the connector and tick that box; disconnect and connect is not enough."
2. CALL `get_issue` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","issueId":"<input:issueId>"} [A]
   SAVE: title = result.title; status = result.status; workspaceId = result.workspaceId
3. SAVE: note = this text, filled, in the user's language:
   ```text
   Evidence pending: API key or web UI.
   Proof offered: <input:proof>
   Not closed: the files must be attached as evidence first.
   ```
4. CALL `create_comment` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","issueId":"<input:issueId>","content":"<saved:note>","idempotencyKey":"evpending-<input:issueId>-<input:stamp>"} [A]
   SAVE: commentId = the id in "Comment created with ID: <id>"
   VERIFY: CALL `list_comments` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","issueId":"<input:issueId>"} [A]
   IF the call returns an error or item <saved:commentId> is missing or has other text → STOP. Say: "Comment <saved:commentId> is not listed with the note."

### Answer (reply with exactly this block, filled in; write nothing before or after it)
```text
Scope: <saved:workspaceId>/<input:projectId>/<input:issueId> <saved:title>
Done: comment <saved:commentId> (evidence pending) | nothing written; status <saved:status>
Evidence: none attached (a connector has no evidence tools)
Pending: attach <input:proof> as files — you, with an LPM API key or the web UI
Next: <the STOP text that ended the run | attach the files in the LPM web UI, then run playbook close with an API key>
```
status: backlog | todo | in-progress | done | canceled, from step 2; this playbook never sets done. Never claim that evidence is attached.
